description: This file contains utility functions related to GStreamer elements, including checks for video and audio decoders and retrieval of specific signal names, within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

methods.name: isVideoDecoder
methods.description: Checks if a given GstElement is a video decoder by inspecting its factory type.

methods.name: isAudioDecoder
methods.description: Checks if a given GstElement is an audio decoder by inspecting its factory type.

methods.name: getUnderflowSignalName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the underflow signal associated with a GstElement, if any.
